@counter\-style descriptor\. Specifies the symbols used by the marker\-construction algorithm specified by the system descriptor\. Needs to be specified if the counter system is 'additive'\.

Syntax: \[ <integer \[0,∞\]> && <symbol> \]\#

Aligns a flex container's lines within the flex container when there is extra space in the cross\-axis, similar to how 'justify\-content' aligns individual items within the main\-axis\.

![Baseline icon](data:image/svg+xml;base64,) _Widely available across major browsers (Baseline since 2015)_

Syntax: normal | <baseline\-position> | <content\-distribution> | <overflow\-position>? <content\-position>

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/align-content)

Aligns flex items along the cross axis of the current line of the flex container\.

![Baseline icon](data:image/svg+xml;base64,) _Widely available across major browsers (Baseline since 2015)_

Syntax: normal | stretch | <baseline\-position> | \[ <overflow\-position>? <self\-position> \] | anchor\-center

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/align-items)

Defines the default justify\-self for all items of the box, giving them the default way of justifying each box along the appropriate axis

![Baseline icon](data:image/svg+xml;base64,) _Widely available across major browsers (Baseline since 2016)_

Syntax: normal | stretch | <baseline\-position> | <overflow\-position>? \[ <self\-position> | left | right \] | legacy | legacy && \[ left | right | center \] | anchor\-center

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/justify-items)

Defines the way of justifying a box inside its container along the appropriate axis\.

Syntax: auto | normal | stretch | <baseline\-position> | <overflow\-position>? \[ <self\-position> | left | right \] | anchor\-center

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/justify-self)

Allows the default alignment along the cross axis to be overridden for individual flex items\.

Syntax: auto | normal | stretch | <baseline\-position> | <overflow\-position>? <self\-position> | anchor\-center

---
Prints the values to a stream, or to sys.stdout by default.

sep  
  string inserted between values, default a space.  
end  
  string appended after the last value, default a newline.  
file  
  a file-like object (stream); defaults to the current sys.stdout.  
flush  
  whether to forcibly flush the stream.
